text: The authors state that ICM cannot elicit any concepts or skills unless they are salient to the pretrained model, and that unsupervised elicitation might be related to data contamination from pretraining. They cannot verify this directly because the Llama pretraining corpus is not accessible, but cite evidence making it less worrying, such as the production assistant training data not being in Claude 4 Sonnet's pretraining corpus.
title: ICM limits: only salient concepts; possible pretraining data contamination
